_comment: Manually curated PDUFA seed entries used as the last-good fallback by
biotech_sniper.calendar.pdufa when the BiopharmCatalyst HTML source is
blocked by Cloudflare or the operator runs the CLI in a sandbox without
outbound network access. Each entry MUST have ticker (uppercase),
drug, action_date (ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD), sponsor, and source_url.
These dates target a rolling 90-day window centered on the bundling
date and are refreshed by future operator runs. They are not guaranteed
to reflect the live FDA pipeline; the live BiopharmCatalyst scrape
supersedes them whenever it succeeds (UPSERT on the composite UNIQUE
